> **SUPERSEDED (Phase 2.1).** This audit's "frozen-feed / stale tail" findings were a misdiagnosis: the frozen 15:15-15:29 window from 2026-08-03 is NSE's Closing Auction Session, real market structure. The holiday findings and the 47-session daily-MA limit have also been resolved. See `docs/phase2/data_repair_report.md`. The text below is kept unchanged as the historical Phase 2 record.
